title: The Turnaround Protocol
subtitle: A high-stakes case study in corporate distress and capital discipline
premise: As interim Chief Restructuring Officer, you have 90 days to steer Horizon Tech out of an impending liquidity crunch.
Balancing payroll, creditor covenants, and core R&D milestones will require unyielding analytical rigor.
Every arrival on your desk tests whether you can spot corporate fallacies and preserve enterprise value.

s001.title: Executive Dilemma Stage 1

arrival.subject: Executive Briefing on Stage 1 Metrics
arrival.body:
Corporate turnaround leadership demands rigorous arithmetic and unwavering discipline under severe market uncertainty. Executives must constantly evaluate liquidity runway, customer acquisition efficiency, gross margin stability, and contractual commitments. Decisions cannot rely on optimistic assumptions or intuitive guesswork; they must be anchored in verifiable unit economics, disciplined risk modeling, and precise operational execution.

Every incoming memorandum, balance sheet report, and client communication contains vital quantitative signals amidst distracting noise. Senior leaders must identify root causes, discard sunk costs, reject false dilemmas, and focus capital allocations exclusively on sustainable enterprise value creation. The boardroom requires structured logic and measurable milestones.

choices.text: Allocate capital according to audited unit economics and milestone validation 1

logic.why: Disciplined capital allocation protects liquidity while driving steady progress.

choices.feedback: The executive committee ratifies the methodical implementation plan.
